facts.fact: The paper 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?' was published on March 31, 2017.
The author of the paper is Amal Doua from the University of Leicester.
The paper investigates whether Hiccup can supply enough fish to maintain the diet of Toothless, a Night Fury dragon.
Toothless is described as the rarest, fastest, and most intelligent of the dragon species in the How to Train Your Dragon franchise.
